brief: Churchill Julius was born in England in 1847. His background was evangelical. After studies at Oxford and various positions in England he became archdeacon of Ballarat in Australia in 1884. He became Bishop of Christchurch in 1890 and developed a strong reputation as an eloquent defender of the rights of workers. He described himself as a Christian Socialist. He was a champion of the role of women in the church. He became primate in 1922, the first in New Zealand to be termed “archbishop”. He retired in 1925 and died in 1938.
